blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reasoning-enabled language model agents can incur substantial computation before acting, although the reasoning needed varies across decisions. Existing stopping signals, such as confidence and intermediate-answer stability, can vary in effectiveness across reasoning models; signals obtained from hidden states or token probabilities also require internal access that may be unavailable or impractical. We introduce StreamStop, which learns model-specific stopping policies offline from prefix-level action agreement. A frozen prefix reader encodes available reasoning text for a lightweight stop head, allowing stopping without access to the reasoning model's internal signals. We construct and publicly release a dataset of agent reasoning trajectories with prefix-level action annotations. These annotations compare each prefix action with the full-reasoning reference action, enabling offline comparison of stopping rules and exact expected-return optimization of a discounted action-agreement objective. Conditioning the head on the discount factor allows the agreement-token trade-off to be adjusted at inference without retraining. In closed-loop evaluations on WebShop and ScienceWorld, StreamStop achieves higher observed success than most validation-selected fixed-budget settings while using fewer reasoning tokens than Full thinking. On WebShop with Qwen3.8-27B, it uses 42% fewer reasoning tokens per episode with similar observed task success.
blocks.zh: 以理性为基础的语言模型代理人在采取行动前可能要进行大量的计算,尽管不同的决定需要不同的推理。 现有的停止信号,如信心和中间答案稳定性,可以因推理模型的不同而发生效力差异;从隐藏状态或象征概率获得的信号也需要内部访问,而内部访问可能无法或不切实际. 我们引入StreatStop,它从前缀级行动协议中学习到针对模式的停止政策离线. 被冻结的前缀阅读器为轻量级停机头编码可用的推理文本,允许不访问推理模型的内部信号而停止. 我们构建并公开发布具有前缀级动作说明的代理推理轨迹数据集. 这些说明将每个前缀动作与完全合理的参考动作进行比较,从而可以对停止规则进行离线比较,并对一个折扣的行动-协议目标进行准确的预期回报优化。 将头部设于折扣因子上,就可以在不进行再培训的情况下,在推论中调整协议式权衡. 在WebShop和ScienceWorld的闭路评价中,StreamStop取得了比大多数验证选择的固定预算设置更高的观测成功,同时使用了比Full思维更少的推理符. 在WebShop与Qwen3.8-27B上,每集使用42%的推理符,类似观测到的任务成功.

blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language model agents interleave reasoning, actions, and observations to solve interactive tasks ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . Lengthy reasoning can delay an agent’s next action, while the amount of reasoning needed varies across decisions ( Bai et al., 2026 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ) . Adaptive stopping aims to determine how much reasoning is sufficient for the next action.
blocks.zh: 语言模型代理交互推理,动作,和观察以解决交互任务(姚等,2023). 冗长的推理会拖延代理人的下一步行动,而需要的推理量则因决定而异(Bai等人,2026年;Zhong等人,2026年)。 适应性停止旨在确定下一步行动有足够的推理。

blocks.en: Some stopping methods use the reasoning model’s hidden representations ( Wu et al., 2025 ) or token probabilities ( Yang et al., 2025 ) to determine when to stop. These signals are unavailable through text-only APIs, and integrating stopping components into large distributed serving systems can be difficult ( Wang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 一些停止方法使用推理模型隐藏的表示(Wu等人,2025年)或符号概率(Yang等人,2025年)来确定何时停止. 这些信号通过仅文本的API无法获取,将停止组件整合到大型分布式服务系统可能很困难(Wang等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Stopping can also be guided by confidence estimates from a separate model or by the stability of intermediate answers, without requiring access to the reasoning model’s internal signals ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025a ) . However, the usefulness of these signals depends on how closely they reflect the reasoning model’s eventual action, and this relationship can vary across models. This calls for stopping criteria that account for the reasoning model’s behavior while balancing action quality against reasoning cost.
blocks.zh: 停止也可以以单独模型的置信估计或中间答案的稳定性为指导,而不需要获取推理模型的内部信号(Wang等人,2025年;Fu等人,2025年a). 然而,这些信号的有用性取决于它们在多大程度上反映了推理模型的最终行动,这种关系可以因模型而异. 这要求停止考虑推理模型行为的标准,同时平衡动作质量和推理成本。

blocks.en: Adaptive stopping requires judging whether the available reasoning is sufficient to determine the next action. Generating a reasoning trajectory and making this sufficiency judgment need not require the same model capacity. Figure 1 (a) compares a 1.7B prefix reader scoring valid action candidates with a 27B reasoning model answering from the same prefixes. Reader agreement with the full-reasoning action increases with prefix length. Panel (b) compares full-reasoning lengths with sufficient-prefix lengths: the earliest observed prefix after which all remaining observed actions agree with the reference. These sufficient prefixes vary across decisions and can be shorter than full reasoning. Together, these diagnostics motivate using a smaller model to assess how much reasoning is needed before generating an action.
blocks.zh: 适应性停止需要判断现有推理是否足以确定下一步行动. 产生推理轨迹和作出这种充分判断不需要同样的模型能力。 图1(a)将1.7B前缀读取器评分有效动作候选人与从同一前缀回答的27B推理模型进行比较. 读者与全理性动作的协议随着前缀长度的增加而增加. 小组(b) 将完全合理的长度与充分的前缀长度进行比较:最早期观察到的前缀,之后所有其余观察到的动作都与参考一致。 这些足够的前缀因决定而异,可以比完全推理短. 这些诊断共同促使人们使用一个较小的模型来评估在采取行动之前需要多少推理。

blocks.en: We introduce StreamStop , a text-based framework that learns model-specific stopping policies offline from prefix-level action agreement. A separate prefix reader processes the available reasoning text, while the reasoning model generates the action from the selected prefix. This stopping interface requires no access to the reasoning model’s hidden states or token probabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们引入 StreamStop(Stream Stop),这是一个基于文本的框架,从前缀级行动协议中学习到针对模式的停机政策。 一个单独的前缀阅读器处理可用的推理文本,而推理模型则从选定的前缀生成动作. 此停止接口不需要访问推理模型的隐藏状态或符号概率 。

blocks.en: StreamStop trains on action agreement : whether an action generated from a partial reasoning prefix matches the full-reasoning reference action. This fits the stopping criterion to the reasoning model’s own prefix-action behavior. A reasoning-cost discount balances reference-action preservation against further reasoning, and recorded prefix outcomes allow exact expected-return optimization over stopping times. Conditioning on the discount factor lets the same trained policy adjust the trade-off between action agreement and reasoning tokens used.
blocks.zh: 运行协议中的 StreamStop列车 : 由部分推理前缀产生的动作是否与完全合理的引用动作匹配。 这与推理模型自身的前缀动作行为相符。 与进一步推理相对应的推理-成本折现余额参考行动保全,以及记录的前缀结果,可以使准确的预期收益在停顿时间得到优化。 以折扣率为条件,同样的训练有素的政策可以调整行动协议与所用推理符之间的权衡。

blocks.en: We evaluate StreamStop across reasoning models in WebShop and ScienceWorld ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Wang et al., 2022 ) . Our contributions are: • A text-based framework that learns model-specific stopping policies offline to reduce reasoning-token use in language model agents, without accessing the reasoning model’s hidden states or token probabilities. • A discounted action-agreement objective for exact expected-return optimization of stopping policies with controllable agreement–token trade-offs. • A dataset of agent reasoning trajectories with actions annotated at multiple prefixes, enabling offline comparison of stopping rules by action agreement and reasoning tokens used.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: DEER uses trial-answer confidence, while Think Just Enough elicits verbal confidence ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . Dynasor-CoT and Answer Consistency monitor intermediate-answer stability ( Fu et al., 2025a ; Liu and Wang, 2025 ) ; DeepConf filters parallel traces by confidence ( Fu et al., 2025b ) . StreamStop learns stopping criteria from the reasoning model’s prefix-level action agreement while accounting for reasoning tokens used.
blocks.zh: DEER使用试答自信,而"Just Enough"则引发口头信心(Yang等人,2025年;Kim等人,2026年). Dynasor-CoT和AnswerConstitution 监控中间回答稳定性(Fu等人,2025年a;Liu和Wang,2025年b);DeepConf通过信心过滤平行痕迹(Fu等人,2025年b). StreamStop从推理模型的前缀级动作协议中学习停止标准,同时计算所使用的推理符号.

blocks.en: Thought calibration and Learn-to-Stop probe internal representations for answer agreement or convergence ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Liu and Wang, 2025 ) . TERMINATOR predicts the eventual answer’s first occurrence, SpecExit augments a speculative draft model, and LearnStop predicts correctness from confidence and stability features ( Nagle et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Dong et al., 2026 ) . StreamStop shares agreement-based supervision with some of these methods, but obtains stopping features from a separate frozen prefix reader. This separates the stopping interface from the reasoning model’s internal representations and token probabilities, making it applicable when only the reasoning text is exposed.
blocks.zh: 思想校准与学习-停止调查内部表述,以达成答案协议或趋同(吴等人,2025年;刘和王,2025年). TERMINATOR预测最终答案的首次出现,SpecExit增加了一个推测的草稿模型,并学习停止从信心和稳定性特征预测正确性(Nagle等人,2026年;Yang等人,2026年;Dong等人,2026年)。 StreamStop与其中一些方法共享基于协议的监管,但从单独的冷冻前缀读取器获取了停止功能. 这将停止接口与推理模型的内部表示和符号概率区分开来,使得仅在推理文本被曝光时才适用.

blocks.en: EAT-proxy monitors entropy stability, FlashThink verifies prefix sufficiency, and PUMA combines redundancy detection with answer verification ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Min et al., 2026 ) . Reasoning that Travels uses receiver agreement to stop provider reasoning ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) . EAT also evaluates an external proxy with a black-box reasoning model ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . The usefulness of these stopping signals can vary across reasoning models. StreamStop learns a model-specific stopping policy offline from prefix-action outcomes under a discounted action-agreement objective, retaining the reasoning model as the action generator.
blocks.zh: EAT-代用监测器的肽稳定性,FlashThink验证前缀是否充足,PUMA结合冗余检测与答案验证(Wang等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2025年;Min等人,2026年). 说明旅行使用接收协议停止提供商推理(Cheng等人,2026年). EAT还评价了一个带有黑盒推理模型的外部代理(Wang等人,2025年). 这些停止信号的有用性可以因推理模型的不同而不同. StreamStop在折扣的动作协议目标下,从前缀动作结果中学习到一个针对模式的停止政策离线,保留推理模型作为动作生成器.

blocks.en: SPORK, DualSpec, and Speculative Actions overlap reasoning or agent execution with speculative actions ( Bai et al., 2026 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . These methods address latency through execution overlap. StreamStop addresses the amount of reasoning needed before each environment action, learning when to stop while balancing action agreement against the number of reasoning tokens used.
blocks.zh: SPORK, DualSpec, and Speculation Actions 将推理或代理执行与投机行为重叠(Bai等人,2026年;Zhong等人,2026年;Ye等人,2026年). 这些方法通过执行重叠来解决延迟问题。 StreamStop处理每次环境行动前需要的推理量,学习何时停止,同时平衡行动协议和所使用的推理符数.

blocks.en: TALE estimates a budget through prompting ( Han et al., 2025 ) ; TokenSkip and ThinkPrune train for shorter reasoning ( Xia et al., 2025 ; Hou et al., 2026 ) . Other methods modify reasoning-model training with efficiency rewards or stop signals ( Arora and Zanette, 2025 ; Qu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . StreamStop keeps both language models frozen and adapts stopping to the available prefix. A discount-conditioned stop head adjusts the trade-off between action agreement and reasoning tokens used without retraining the language models or fitting a separate head for each budget.
blocks.zh: TALE通过催促(Han等人,2025年)估算预算;TokenSkip和ThinkPrune列车用于缩短推理(Xia等人,2025年;Hou等人,2026年). 其他方法以效率奖励或停止信号修改推理-模型培训(Arora和Zanette,2025年;Qu等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年)。 流线 停止使两种语言模型都冻结,并适应可用的前缀. 以折扣为条件的停机头可以调整行动协议与使用的推理符之间的取舍,而不对语言模型进行再培训,也不为每个预算设置一个单独的头。

blocks.en: Tasks are divided into training, validation, and test sets before trajectory collection. WebShop uses 3,117 training goals and 320 validation goals. ScienceWorld uses the same 1,200 training and 60 validation task variations for Qwen3.8 and Gemini. Each task, together with all trajectories and prefixes collected from it, belongs to only one split. The test set contains 200 WebShop goals and 149 ScienceWorld variations, shared across reasoning models within each environment.

blocks.en: We collect trajectories from the frozen reasoning model with Full thinking, recording the public context, reasoning stream, full-reasoning reference action, and environment outcome at each decision. We then generate actions from prefixes at 16-token intervals, including the empty prefix and final checkpoint, without advancing the environment. Annotation continues after the first reference match because later prefixes can disagree. Appendix C gives the model prompts.

Each stream represents a decision attempt, and each prefix-action annotation pairs the available reasoning text with the action generated from it. These prefix-action annotations support offline comparison of stopping rules on the same recorded decisions using action agreement and reasoning tokens used, without additional reasoning-model calls or environment rollouts. For training and validation, we use a filtered subset from successful episodes to reduce the risk of preserving incorrect reference actions (Appendix A.1 ). The dataset is publicly available through our project page.

blocks.en: We include Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite, a closed-weight model from a frontier model family, to examine StreamStop’s applicability through an API. Since its raw native reasoning is not exposed, we disable native thinking and elicit an explicit plan as an observable reasoning proxy. StreamStop selects a prefix of this plan, and the same Gemini model generates the environment action from that prefix in closed-loop evaluation. This provides a proxy evaluation of text-based stopping without access to the reasoning model’s hidden states or token probabilities. Full thinking with the complete plan improves task success over No thinking (Table 2 ). Appendix B details the protocol and evaluation.

blocks.en: 5.2 Baselines

blocks.en: We compare StreamStop with five baselines. Full thinking generates the complete reasoning stream before acting, whereas No thinking generates an action with reasoning disabled. Const- k k stops after a fixed reasoning-token budget; Const-B γ and Const-M γ select this budget on validation data to match StreamStop at γ \gamma using nominal budgets or realized reasoning-token counts. EAT-proxy uses the stability of token-prediction entropy from a frozen external model to decide when to stop ( Wang et al., 2025 ) . Dynasor-CoT stops when repeated action requests from intermediate prefixes produce consistent answers ( Fu et al., 2025a ) .

blocks.zh: 在每个配置中,改变 γ\gamma 用相同的训练有素的停机头来调整推理-token的使用,提供多个权衡,而不对每个预算的政策进行再培训.

blocks.en: While EAT-proxy and Dynasor-CoT outperform fixed budgets in some configurations, their relative performance varies across reasoning models. EAT-proxy has the highest reported success in ScienceWorld–Gemini, whereas Dynasor-CoT outperforms the matched fixed budgets in WebShop–Nemotron.
blocks.zh: 虽然EAT-proxy和Dynasor-CoT在一些配置中超过了固定预算,但其相对性能因推理模型而异. EAT-代理在ScienceWorld – Gemini(英语:Science World–Gemini)中的成功率最高,而Dynasor-CoT在WebShop–Nemotron中的表现则超过了相应的固定预算.

blocks.en: The higher success with shorter reasoning on WebShop–Nemotron may reflect overthinking. Prior work reports redundant reasoning ( Chen et al., 2025 ) and cases where continued reasoning leads a model to abandon a correct answer ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Adaptive stopping may help when further reasoning degrades an action that could already be taken.
blocks.zh: 在WebShop-Nemotron上以更短的推理方式取得更高的成功可能反映了过度思考. 前工作报告冗余推理(Chen等人,2025年)和持续推理导致模式放弃正确答案的案例(周等人,2026年). 如果进一步推理会贬低已经可以采取的行动,适应性停止可能有所帮助。

blocks.en: 5.5 Latency Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.5 延迟分析

blocks.en: StreamStop reduces decision latency relative to Full thinking (Figure 3 a–c). Reader updates are typically much shorter than reasoning-chunk arrival intervals (Figure 3 d), allowing prefix processing to overlap generation. Across StreamStop’s evaluated local-model settings, waiting for the prefix reader accounts for a median 0.56% of mean decision latency. Appendix A.4 details the timing analysis.
blocks.zh: StreamStop 相对全面思考(图3 a-c)减少决策延迟。 阅读器的更新通常比推理-chunk到达间隔时间短得多(图3 d),允许前缀处理重叠生成. StreatStop评价了本地模式设置, 附录A.4详细列出了时间安排分析。

blocks.en: 5.6 Validation Action-Agreement Curves
blocks.zh: 5.6 审定行动-协定曲线

blocks.en: To extend the validation comparison to larger discount factors, we train a separate head over a wider discount range. Figure 4 reports its action agreement and reasoning-token use on recorded validation decisions. Action agreement measures preservation of the full-reasoning action. Full thinking achieves higher task success than No thinking across the evaluated configurations (Table 2 ), making reference preservation a useful diagnostic of earlier stopping. This connects to prior stopping criteria based on intermediate-answer stability ( Fu et al., 2025a ) and agreement with the full-budget answer ( Wu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了将验证对比扩大到更大的折扣系数,我们将一个单独的头训练在更大的折扣范围内. 图4报告了记录的审定决定的行动协议和推理式使用。 行动协议措施是维护充分合理的行动。 充分思维比没有经过评估的配置(表2)实现更高的任务成功率,使参考保存成为早期停止的有益诊断. 这与基于中间回答稳定性(Fu等人,2025年a)和同意全预算答案(Wu等人,2025年)的预先停止标准有关。

blocks.en: StreamStop generally achieves higher action agreement than fixed-budget stopping with similar numbers of reasoning tokens used (Figure 4 ). EAT-proxy and Dynasor-CoT show gains that vary across reasoning models and budgets, whereas StreamStop trains directly on each model’s prefix-action agreement.
blocks.zh: StreamStop一般会比固定预算达到更高的动作协议,停止使用类似的推理符号(图4). EAT-代理和Dynasor-CoT显示不同推理模式和预算的不同收益,而StreamStop列车则直接在每一个模型的前缀操作协议上.

blocks.en: Figure 4 (b) also shows that increasing short fixed budgets initially lowers action agreement. StreamStop’s action-agreement curve does not exhibit the same initial dip. Appendix A gives the curve settings.
blocks.zh: 图4(b)还显示,增加短期固定预算最初会降低行动协议。 StreamStop 的动作协议曲线没有表现出相同的初始曲线。 附 录 A 给出曲线设置 。

blocks.en: 5.7 Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.7 定性分析

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows two Qwen3.8 WebShop validation decisions ( γ = 0.99 \gamma=0.99 ). In (a), StreamStop stops at a prefix proposing inspection of a hoodie below the price limit, matching the reference action. Later reconsideration favors moving to another results page, which is the action selected by Const-M and EAT-proxy.
blocks.zh: 图5显示两个WebShop验证决定(γ=0.99\gamma=0.99),在(a)中,StreamStop停在前缀建议检查低于限价的连帽衫,匹配参考动作. 后来的复议倾向于移动到另一个结果页,即Const-M和EAT-proxy选择的动作.

blocks.en: In (b), early reasoning considers selecting a size. The later prefix identifies that the current item is unlikely to satisfy the request and proposes returning to search. StreamStop waits for this product-mismatch judgment, matching the reference action, while earlier baselines select the size.
blocks.zh: 在(b)中,早期推理考虑选择大小. 后面的前缀识别出当前项目不太可能满足请求,并提议返回搜索. StreamStop等待此产品- mismatch 判断,匹配参考动作,而更早的基线选择大小.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: StreamStop learns model-specific stopping policies offline from prefix-level action agreement. Its discounted objective and discount-conditioned head adjust the agreement–token trade-off without retraining, while a frozen prefix reader enables text-based stopping without access to the reasoning model’s internal signals. Across WebShop and ScienceWorld, it uses fewer reasoning tokens than Full thinking and achieves higher observed success than most validation-selected fixed budgets.
blocks.zh: StreamStop从前缀级动作协议中学习特定模式的停止政策离线. 而冷冻的前缀阅读器则可以在无法访问推理模型内部信号的情况下基于文本停止。 在整个WebShop和ScienceWorld中,它使用的推理符号比Full思维要少,并且比大多数验证选择的固定预算获得更高的观测成功.

blocks.en: The dataset is publicly available through our project page. In addition to completed trajectories, the dataset records actions generated from intermediate prefixes under the same environment context. This makes stopping choices directly comparable on the same decisions, without additional reasoning-model calls or environment rollouts. These annotations support offline training and analysis of how action agreement changes with reasoning-token use.
blocks.zh: 数据集可通过我们的项目网页公开查阅。 除了完成的轨迹外,数据集还记录了在同一环境背景下由中间前缀产生的动作. 这使得停止选择可直接比较于同一决定,而无需额外的推理模型呼叫或环境推出. 这些说明支持线下培训,并分析行动协议如何随着推理式使用而改变。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Action agreement uses the full-reasoning action as a reference, which can itself be incorrect. Training trajectories come from successful collection episodes and may not cover all contexts encountered after early stopping changes the agent’s actions.
blocks.zh: 行动协议以充分合理行动作为参考,其本身可能不正确。 培训的轨迹来自成功的收集事件,可能无法涵盖早期停止改变代理行为后遇到的所有情况。

blocks.en: Table 1 counts the full training- and validation-task collection, including successful and unsuccessful episodes. Episodes are separate task runs, including repeated sampling of a task. blocks.en: A.2 Prefix Reader and Stop Head
blocks.zh: A.2 前缀阅读器和停止头

blocks.en: Checkpoints advance by 16 tokens from the empty prefix, ending at stream completion or the stopping cap. The reader feature z t z_{t} is the 2,048-dimensional final-layer representation at the last token of the answer cue minus its empty-prefix counterpart (Appendix C.3 ). The head also receives normalized checkpoint progress, arrived-token count, a stream-ended flag, and available-action count. Appendix D compares these inputs with metadata-only and context-only controls. At matched token budgets, the full inputs yield higher action agreement in all four configurations, supporting the use of reader features that depend on the available reasoning prefix.
blocks.zh: 检查点从空前缀提前16个令牌,以流完成或停止盖结束. 读取功能 z t z_{t}是2,048维的终极层代表,位于答题最后一个符号减去其空前缀对应物(Appendix C.3 ). 头部还收到正常的检查站进展、抵达的计数、流线旗和可用行动计数。 附 录 D将这些输入与仅元数据和仅上下文控制进行比较. 在匹配的代号预算中,全部投入在所有四个配置中都产生更高的动作协议,支持使用依赖于现有推理前缀的阅读器功能.

blocks.en: The head has 263,330 trainable parameters. Its main branch uses non-affine layer normalization and a tanh hidden layer. A separate tanh branch adds a discount-conditioned scalar to the WAIT logit, using normalized log ⁡ ( 1 / ( 1 − γ ) ) \log(1/(1-\gamma)) , Fourier features, and checkpoint progress. Zero-initialized output layers and a fixed WAIT bias initialize a uniform first-stop prior over the maximum checkpoint grid; terminal stopping is forced.
blocks.zh: 头部有263,330个可列车参数. 其主要分支采用非亚芬地层正常化和坦赫隐藏层. 一个单独的Tanh分支在等待记录中增加了一个折扣条件的scalar,使用普通的log QQ(1 / (1 – Q ))\log(1/(1-\gamma)),Fourier特性和检查站进度。 零初始化输出层和固定的等待偏差在最大检查网格上先初始化一个统一的一站;终端被迫停止.

blocks.zh: 培训使准确的预期返回目标得到优化,而不必使用肽化规范或监督的等待标签。

blocks.en: Full inputs achieve higher matched-budget agreement than metadata-only and context-only controls in all four configurations, supporting prefix-dependent features beyond progress and context alone.
